summary.method: Actually viewed one decoded midpoint per unique directed pose pair, five distributed frames for fixed-source clips, flagged pages, 44 exact-SHA frames for 11 trim rerenders, and 24 latest-SHA frames (including eight held poses) for four overhang repacks.
limitations: All frames were decoded automatically; human anatomy/equipment assessment was sampled. Neither successful decode nor low temporal-difference metrics establish visual correctness.
No action receives an all-frame or pixel-locked equipment pass. No-obvious-defect-in-selected-samples is deliberately narrower.
Original repository video choreography was not compared frame-for-frame; AIRI runtime playback was not exercised by this reviewer.
Five emotion actions were replaced by the parent. Their old findings remain superseded; the separate emotion review owns the new SHA, not this report.
Two repacked atlases caused 16 videos to be reexported. Four target clips were rechecked; the other 12 changed SHAs are explicitly unreviewed here and old observations are superseded.
